verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: [1] 98% of late trains were already late at 50 St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 86 St: 185, at 79 St: 4, at or before 79 St: 4, on approach from 72 St: 2.
[1] 85% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 50 St.
[2] 99% of late trains were already late at 72 St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 135 St: 129, at 125 St: 5, at 116 St: 4, at 72 St: 4.
[2] 82% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 72 St.
[3] 98% of late trains were already late at 72 St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 135 St: 62, at 125 St: 4, at 96 St: 4, at or before 96 St: 3.
[3] 77% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 72 St.
Weekend problem rate is 1.7x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
34% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 3.1x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 18% of delays on line(s) 1, 2, 3 (0.8x the system share) in the analysed months.
[3] 64% of late trains were already late leaving Harlem-148 St: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[2] Trains that would arrive at 72 St within 180s behind a 1/3 train lose 193s more there than others (p=0.001; 62% of trips affected); 52% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 140s on average vs 67s otherwise (2.1x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 27% of delays on line(s) 1, 2, 3 (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 32% of delays on line(s) 1, 2, 3 (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Van Cortlandt Park-242 St during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at 72 St, where 1, 3 trains run ahead of 2 trains bound for Times Sq-42 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for 1, 2, 3; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for 1, 2, 3; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so 1, 3 and 2 slots are offset by at least half a headway at 72 St
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of Times Sq-42 St; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
caveats: scheduled counts scaled by observed coverage (832 polling intervals); hours covered < 50% excluded from service delivered
no hour of the day worsened significantly versus the baseline; results describe the whole day
